authority: JP_Structural_Analysis post-Seq9 draft branch; no automatic V0.1 release
precedent_scope: Two source structural reports: G+1.5 residential and G+2.5 mixed-use. Confidential originals stay in private Drive.
code_basis: NBC 105:2025 for new seismic work, NBC 206:2024 architectural, NBC 205:2024 only after eligibility and 2025 compatibility proof. IS editions require verified clause basis.

status_definitions.IMPLEMENTED_BOUNDED: Implemented and regression-tested for limited configurations, NOT automatically fit for all precedent cases.
status_definitions.PARTIAL: Some calculations exist, but the report-level requirements are not fully covered.
status_definitions.DRAFT_UNVALIDATED: Prototype or formula arithmetic exists, but code/reliability validation is not complete.
status_definitions.MISSING: No corresponding complete design/check engine is implemented.

live_pages_warning: Public GitHub Pages is pinned to a separately validated published M09 numeric codex commit; this in-development D1B upgrade is not yet deployed to Pages.

requirements.title: Material and section properties
requirements.remaining_scope: Source-linked density, cracked/modified stiffness and RC material states; no implicit M20/M25 property selection.
requirements.validation_gate: Source-backed E, G, A, I; units, property uncertainty and material conflict tests.

requirements.title: Gravity loads and seismic mass
requirements.remaining_scope: Bounded source-to-node gravity and seismic mass allocation, conservative center-of-mass, canonical OpenSees mass binding, isolated gravity static solver, and support free-body checks are implemented. Automatic tributary geometry/real load-path identification, distributed frame/area load mapping, shell behavior and source model equivalence remain unresolved.
requirements.validation_gate: Synthetic OpenSees frame vertical Rz/Mx/My equilibrium PASS; reject duplicate source keys, geometry drift, existing mass or unsupported units. Real project geometry/source comparison and member-load response benchmarks still pending.

requirements.title: Equivalent static seismic loading
requirements.remaining_scope: NBC105:2025 §§4.1–4.2, 5.1–5.3 and 6.1–6.3: audited ESM/MRSM spectra for T<=6 s, RC frame period, ULS/SLS coefficients, live mass factors, and bounded ELF forces implemented. Actual site class/zoning, verified Rayleigh result, FE application of accidental torsion, P-Delta, complete independent numerical benchmarks and design acceptance remain pending.
requirements.validation_gate: Government 2025 source exact clauses/pdfs, functional branch tests and load-mass conservation verified; site-evidence and real model checks remain gated.

requirements.title: 3D elastic FE and member force recovery
requirements.remaining_scope: Real building gravity/static cases, complete local member force diagrams, reaction-source benchmark, shell/release/offset parity.
requirements.validation_gate: Independent free-body equilibrium, supported geometry benchmark and member P/V/M/T comparison.

requirements.title: Modal and response spectrum
requirements.remaining_scope: All supported dynamic load cases, verified 90% participation rule where applicable, actual building mass source and scaling.
requirements.validation_gate: Mode/mass check, SRSS/CQC hand examples, independent spectrum and scaling benchmarks.

requirements.title: Seismic and load combinations
requirements.remaining_scope: Complete edition-controlled ULS/SLS, 5% accidental eccentricity if applicable, vertical action, orthogonal interaction. Implemented bounded §5.6 torsion ACTION PAIRS, not equivalent FE torsion; §7.5 force-only MRSM scaling (no drift/displacement scaling).
requirements.validation_gate: Combination family coverage and governing-demand envelope compared with independent values.

requirements.title: Storey response and seismic irregularities
requirements.remaining_scope: Proper storey stiffness, lateral displacement/drift, torsional ratios, center of rigidity, mass and P-Delta acceptance. Verified §3.4 effective flexural stiffness factors, §5.5.3 design-drift limits, and §7.3 conservative modal-mass screening implemented; actual whole-model irregularity acceptance incomplete.
requirements.validation_gate: Numerical ratios with explicit ULS/SLS code limits, mode/axis/units and evidence per storey.

requirements.title: RC beam design
requirements.remaining_scope: Bounded NBC105:2025 seismic beam end shear envelope now implemented using four source-identified end hinge strengths and FE/gravity actions; full bar layouts and signed force transfer/negative flexure/torsion still pending.
requirements.validation_gate: CI synthetic stress-block equilibrium, inverse steel sizing, min/max steel, over-reinforced FAIL, Tables 19/20 spot checks, under-strength stirrup FAIL. Machine-verified Table19 is necessary but not a completed RC beam design: tension-bar continuity, NBC seismic detailing, actual envelopes and engineering signoff remain HOLD. Numeric reference and negative test: tests/native/test_rc_report_kernels.py; assumed machine report: scripts/build_rc_reference_case.py; F3 fail preservation: tests/native/test_f3_source_reconciliation.py.

requirements.title: RC column P-M-M design
requirements.remaining_scope: First-party M09 strain compatibility now integrates Fe415/Fe500 steel against digitized SP16 Table A/IS456 Fig23A total-strain points with linear interpolation and 4 signed X/Y compression-face P-M curves (65 neutral-axis samples plus c=D and target-Pu root). It computes factored Pu axial equilibria and §39.6 biaxial interaction. Published Table A knots independently checked in tests. Still PARTIAL: full published SP16 column interaction chart comparison, independent section capacity validation, signed FE action mapping, eccentricity/slenderness second order, NBC Annex A confinement and detailing, sourcing actual bars and professional approval remain HOLD. Two published SP16 Chart31-related independent hand examples are now matched within 0.7% normalized moment (and 0.5% neutral-axis ratio), with numeric benchmark JSON and hard CI gates; original BIS chart ordinate digitization is not yet checked.
requirements.validation_gate: Fe415/500 SP16 Table A independent values, odd symmetry/continuity/monotonicity, rotation invariance of X/Y interaction curves, four signed compression faces and target Pu equilibrium, synthetic high-biaxial FAIL and bad-input rejection; tests/native/test_rc_column_section.py and scripts/build_m09_section_case.py. Independent published SP16 full column interaction-chart points and real source geometry are required before engineering approval. Two external worked examples for Fe415 Chart31 d'/D=.05, p/fck=.02 with Pu/fckbD=.25 and .44 must match independently published normalized moments .081575 and .028979 within 0.7% and roots within 0.5%. This is an independently derived hand-example benchmark, NOT directly digitized original SP16 chart data.

requirements.title: Seismic joints and hierarchy
requirements.remaining_scope: NBC105:2025 joint shear capacity and interior/exterior horizontal joint demand now executable with explicit effective joint area and confinement class; joint confinement/anchorage and strong-column hierarchy remain incomplete.
requirements.validation_gate: Verified joint equilibrium, capacity ratios and detailing figures with code-traceable tests. Prechecks are NOT equivalent to full RC design. Numeric reference and negative test: tests/native/test_rc_report_kernels.py; assumed machine report: scripts/build_rc_reference_case.py; F3 fail preservation: tests/native/test_f3_source_reconciliation.py.

requirements.title: Slab design
requirements.remaining_scope: Actual two-way slabs, edge conditions, Table 26 coefficient basis, steel, serviceability and punching where needed.
requirements.validation_gate: Validated two-way coefficient worksheets and stiffness-independent hand checks.

requirements.title: Rigid isolated/combined footing
requirements.remaining_scope: Numerical M12 now handles (a) concentric interior isolated pads: service soil pressure, two-way strip flexure, one-way shear and d/2 punching; (b) rigid rectangular combined footing: actual eccentric resultant, nonuniform full-contact pressure, exact force/moment equilibrium, factored bending envelope, provisional top/bottom flexure. Historical F3 NOT SAFE is preserved and source-F3/CF1 reconstruction jobs execute in CI. Outstanding: combined-footing critical shear/punching, combined reinforcement anchorage, eccentric isolated footings outside full contact, soil settlement, geotechnical source verification, actual column coordinates, true load combinations and independent FE benchmark.
requirements.validation_gate: Tests test_rc_report_kernels.py, test_f3_source_reconciliation.py, test_cf1_source_reconciliation.py; workflow uploads assumed RC, F3 unsafe and CF1 combined footing machine-readable artifacts. Full building approval not established.

requirements.title: Subgrade/raft FE
requirements.remaining_scope: Winkler foundation mesh, non-tension soil, bearing pressure, deflection, plate and punching demand.
requirements.validation_gate: Known plate/spring benchmarks and independent foundation reaction equilibrium.

requirements.title: Open-well staircase design
requirements.remaining_scope: Flight slope self-weight, step volumes, landing reaction, bending, shear and reinforcement.
requirements.validation_gate: Hand-verified flight and landing examples with thickness consistency gate.

requirements.title: Lift/equipment and special loads
requirements.remaining_scope: Lift car/counterweight/machine-room load paths, dynamic allowances where applicable.
requirements.validation_gate: Source-based equipment capacities and load-path conservation; G+1.5 not forced to include lift.

requirements.title: Wind-load screening
requirements.remaining_scope: Wind actions for governing comparisons rather than assuming seismic always governs.
requirements.validation_gate: Computed wind action/envelope with relevant code and project-specific exposure parameters.

requirements.title: Source QA, numerical verification and provenance
requirements.remaining_scope: Independent solver adapter operationalization, source conflict gates, full numeric checks and immutable run identifiers.
requirements.validation_gate: No unknown result marked PASS, report reaction discrepancy unresolved until reconciled.

requirements.title: Complete report/PDF/website projection
requirements.remaining_scope: Consume validated results from R&D LaTeX renderer; numbered equations, force diagrams, checks, citations and private/public separation.
requirements.validation_gate: Every report item links to computation run and code edition; no private project publication.
